reviews.text: Great work transferring a laserdisc (actually a CDV) to a modern digital format. Another service tried and failed but I found total satisfaction here.
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.text: I reached out to Green Tree AV regarding a tape I found amongst my late fathers things. It was sent to his parents during the Vietnam War. I didn't know if the audio could be recovered from it as it's over 50 years old. Andy assured me it would be no problem.
reviews.author: Garron M.

reviews.text: Greentree AV was able to digitize two rather obscure and completely obsolete video formats (Unimatic and Sony / Ampex reel to reel) in a timely manner and at a competitive rate. Received originals back in the mail without any delay. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: John B.
